import xml.dom.minidom

    content = f.read()
doc = xml.dom.minidom.parseString(content)
for i, p in enumerate(doc.getElementsByTagName('w:p')):
    texts = ''.join([t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else '' for t in p.getElementsByTagName('w:t')])
    if not texts.strip():
        continue
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName('w:pPr')
    rPrs = p.getElementsByTagName('w:rPr')
    # summarize rPr children
    info = []
    for rpr in rPrs:
        kids = [c.tagName.split('}')[1] for c in rpr.childNodes if c.nodeType == 1]
        info.append(','.join(kids))
    print(f'P{i}: [{texts[:60]}] rPr=[{\" | \".join(info)}]')
"
